rationale: This change strengthens the existing Permanent Canonical + Promotion Gate so every workflow linked to Current Host by filename or semantic marker is fail-closed checked for immutable 40-hex GitHub Action pins, and pins the seven additional linked workflows exposed by that new guard. It changes only CI/policy validation and GitHub Action identity binding; workflow runtime commands, triggers, runner placement, providers, device/resource allocation, host services, proof recipes, evidence semantics, hardware behavior and promotion authority are unchanged. Therefore no fresh physical Current Host requalification or FULL-525 replay is required.
